ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a praying mantis in side view, with the head and thorax near the upper/front area and a pair of large folded appendages attached close to the front of the body. These appendages are bent like arms and positioned for grasping. Reasoning: The question asks which part of a praying mantis is modified for grasping. In praying mantises, the raptorial forelimbs used to seize prey are the front legs.
